solutionSql:
SELECT id,
       LEFT(tracking_code, 2) AS prefix,
       (booked_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS booked_day
FROM shipments
WHERE id BETWEEN 1 AND 10
ORDER BY id;
notes: UTC is written explicitly, so the calendar date does not depend on the session time zone. Ids 1 and 2 fall on 2026-01-31 and the rest on 2025-12-28.
